limits: Real built loopback Host/World, paused isolated Run, production workers/viewports; no production instrumentation or model changes.

Dispatch and milestones use World performance.now. A matching prepared-array/VBO draw is observed. Full-site cold completion requires both actual source-family cohorts (four unit instances and one campus) BEFORE a new microtask GPU fence; pending0/DOMready alone cannot satisfy it. Fence completion is not a physical-monitor timestamp.

Vector Plan is a separate Canvas2D milestone: actual matching-level ink after source drawing or prepared-view evidence, then two RAF scheduling frames with no pending jobs. No WebGL fence or GPU-completion claim is attached to Canvas2D paint.
Prepared response includes queue/worker/transfer; no controller-ready timestamp is claimed without a product hook. First matching draw proves admission occurred by that point.

WeakMap tags and primitive-only logs do not retain prepared arrays across forced GC. Instrumentation adds overhead; draw-wrapper diagnostic cost is reported separately and does not include every wrapper.

BSP jobs are tracked separately and never misclassified as solid preparation; an opaque first-draw milestone need not wait for an independent background transparency cohort. All worker targets must terminate on page closure. No fixed settlement sleeps. Initial controls mount is separate from layout completion. One GPU/profile/device and local services; full-product and isolated-engine timings are not interchangeable.
